Saved Views is available today for all customers on paid plans. This new feature lets you capture the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on, so your favorite way of looking at a project is always one click away instead of being rebuilt from scratch every time.

Each user can save up to 50 views, covering every board, sprint, or backlog you manage across your workspace. Whether you track bugs by priority, sort tasks by due date, or group work by owner, your setups stay ready whenever you need them.

Saved views aren't just for you. Any view can be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same filtered perspective without repeating setup steps or explaining configurations in chat. This keeps standups, reviews, and planning sessions aligned around a single source of truth.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no extra cost, giving every team a faster way to organize and communicate project status.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
